description: This file defines a custom culture information object for the 'quz-PE' (Quechua - Peru) locale, including localized names for days, months, date formats, regex patterns, timezone info, and date-related utility functions. It appears to be part of the DateJS library or an extension thereof, providing localization support for date parsing and formatting.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects represent the same moment.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a given year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the abbreviation of a timezone based on its offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a timezone based on its name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures date components on a Date object based on provided configuration.
